item.title: Mitigating CVE-2026-114938 ("Java4Shell") in Apache Kafka deployments
item.description: CVE-2026-114938, also known as “Java4Shell”, is a vulnerability in the JDK that can affect Apache Kafka® deployments. The flaw is in an AVX-512 VBMI intrinsic that OpenJDK uses on x86-64 CPUs to speed up Base64 decoding. Because the vulnerability is in the JDK, Kafka itself needs no upgrade or code change. The fix is to upgrade your JDK. Until you can, a JVM flag disables the affected code.
